heading: Score computation
relates:
  depends-on: ["501.3"]

  - source: Retrieval design note 2026-08-01
    accessed: "2026-08-01"
---

Each candidate's score is computed from term frequency against the tokenized
query. The middle of the chain: reached at one hop from 501.1, and the leaf
whose own neighbor (501.3) must be absent from 501.1's neighborhood.

Its `depends-on` deliberately cites 501.3 by NOTATION while 501.3 carries an
accession — both citation forms are legal (UCS-1144), so a neighborhood entry
must resolve either spelling to the same leaf.
